parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Omit to get both platforms

put.summary: Set the latest / minimum version for a platform
put.description: Call after the new build is live on the store. Installed versions below latestVersion get an optional update dialog; below minVersion the dialog cannot be dismissed. storeUrl is required the first time a platform is added.

post.description: Sends to every active user. Call once the version is live on both stores. Tapping the notification opens the store when the device has an update.

get.summary: Customer history by phone (used while adding an order)
get.description: stats: delivered / returned / in-progress counts and rates over all of the company\'s orders for this phone (counts only). lastOrder: recipient name and address from the caller\'s own orders (client: their orders; staff: the company), or null.
The client\'s orders with status PROCESSING. state=pending lists not processed orders, state=processed lists processed or confirmed ones (with the latest client processing). counts has both totals.

patch.description: Client processes an order in PROCESSING: sets processingStatus=processed, clientNotes, and a new first phone for CHANGE_PHONE, then adds an ORDER_PROCESS timeline entry and notifies the delivery agent and inquiry employees. The order status is not changed.

400.description: Order is not in PROCESSING, or invalid phone

get.description: Loans of the company (branch managers: their branch clients). openTotal/openCount sum open loans for the same client filter.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: true: deleted loans (with deletedAt and deletedBy)

post.summary: Pay a loan (سلفة) to a client
post.description: Creates a WITHDRAW treasury transaction for the amount and an open loan. Open loans are deducted from the client\'s next delivered client report; creating that report is refused while open loans exceed its net. Deleting the transaction cancels an open loan.

delete.description: Only loans not deducted in a report. Deletes its treasury withdrawal; the loan is kept with deletedAt/deletedBy for deleted items (GET /client-loans?deleted=true).

patch.description: Only loans not deducted in a report. Updates the loan and its treasury withdrawal (amount and description). A loan released by a deleted report: note only.

get.description: Delivered orders without a delivered client report (count, totals), open loans, amount due, and blockReason when a request is not allowed (no store chosen, pending request, unconfirmed delivered reports, no orders, loans above net). Clients with more than one store (storeRequired) pass store_id; stores lists the orders and net of each store.

storeID.description: Required when the client has more than one store

get.description: The delivered client report template filled with the orders the client asked for, marked as a draft (nothing is saved). Pending: the orders approval would report and the open loans it would deduct. Clients see only their own requests.

post.description: Creates the client\'s delivered report now, one per store with eligible orders, through the regular report creation (loans are deducted). With RECEIVING_AGENT the report is assigned to the client\'s receiving agent when exactly one is assigned. failures lists stores whose report could not be made.
